profile.name: Raj Shah
profile.tagline: AI & ML Engineer building geospatial AI systems, RAG applications, and production ML pipelines.
profile.specialization: Production ML Systems · RAG · Evaluation · Deployment
profile.bio:
I am a Computer Science and Data Science graduate from Rutgers University with Honors in both majors, a 3.792 GPA, and multiple Dean's List recognitions. Currently, I work as an AI & ML Engineer at Boundary RSS, where I build end-to-end machine learning pipelines, scalable inference systems, preprocessing workflows, and production-style AI solutions across large geological datasets. My work spans Python, SQL, Pandas, Scikit-learn, Parquet, ETL pipelines, data validation, confidence scoring, and backend ML workflows designed for scalable prediction and downstream analytics integration.

I enjoy building practical AI systems that solve real-world problems. I have developed AI-powered RAG chatbots using LangChain and DeepSeek APIs, built FastAPI-based AI applications integrating IBM Cloud and real-time APIs, and worked on NLP-driven financial prediction systems using FinBERT, XGBoost, Random Forest, and time-series machine learning models. My focus is Generative AI, AI infrastructure, ML engineering, backend AI systems, LLM workflows, AI agents, cloud deployment, and production-scale applications where engineering and business impact align.

experience.summary: Contribute to a production-oriented Geospatial AI agent framework for subsurface exploration, reservoir characterization, and hydrocarbon analytics — improving architecture, scalability, and integration readiness across Python ML pipelines and multimodal data workflows.
highlights: Built and optimized well-log ML pipelines (Pandas, NumPy), reducing preprocessing errors from ~20% to <5%.
Trained and evaluated models using MSE, RMSE, and R² — RMSE ↓ ~15–20%, R² improved from ~0.65 to ~0.78.
Integrated and validated 13+ heterogeneous datasets (seismic, well-log, gravity, magnetic, hyperspectral, SAR, EM, thermal, geochemical) for multimodal fusion.
Developed Subsurface Characterization AI modules with open-source geospatial + ML libraries for scalable ingestion.
Automated preprocessing → inference → post-processing workflows, cutting manual effort by ~40%.
Supported API-based integration into distributed AI systems with GIS compatibility (QGIS, ArcGIS, Google Earth).

experience.summary: Delivered validated datasets, SQL/Python analytics, Tableau dashboards, and KPI insights for leadership and outreach strategy.
highlights: Cleaned and validated 1,500+ records with SQL and Python (Pandas, NumPy), improving data accuracy by ~25%.
Performed EDA to identify trends, correlations, and donor behavior patterns for KPI-driven decisions.
Wrote optimized SQL (JOINs, GROUP BY, aggregations), reducing manual processing time by ~30%.
Built interactive Tableau dashboards for KPIs and performance metrics, improving stakeholder reporting efficiency.

projects.title: EvacAI — AI-Powered Disaster Preparedness Platform
projects.subtitle: IBM Z × UNSA Hackathon · iOS + deployed web platform
projects.description: Built EvacAI to help users respond during floods, hurricanes, wildfires, earthquakes, and severe weather with live weather, disaster alerts, shelters, ML-based risk scoring, and AI-generated evacuation plans. FastAPI backend integrates geocoding, alerts, weather, resources, and planning; IBM watsonx/Granite and Cloud Object Storage power AI response planning.
projects.metrics: Full-stack platform · Live weather + risk scoring · Global location support

projects.title: FOMC Yield Curve Prediction Using NLP & Machine Learning
projects.subtitle: 189 FOMC statements (1994–2024) + FRED macro features
projects.description: Predicted short-term U.S. Treasury yield movements using Federal Reserve language and macro data. Engineered NLP features with TF-IDF drift, hawkish/dovish lexicons, and FinBERT sentiment; trained Ridge, Lasso, Random Forest, and XGBoost with walk-forward validation to reduce look-ahead bias.

projects.title: RU-PATH — AI-Powered Parking & Transit Chatbot
projects.subtitle: Rutgers-focused RAG assistant for parking + bus routing
projects.description: Built a LangChain + DeepSeek RAG chatbot covering 5 permit types and 6 bus routes with semantic search, NLU intent routing, and modular parking/routing engines. Flask REST APIs support real-time multi-turn queries across campuses; deployed with Docker, GitHub Actions, and Render.
projects.metrics: ~89% response accuracy · 99% production uptime · 1,500+ lines modular Python

projects.title: Automated Data Collection & Analysis Pipeline

projects.metrics: ~80% time reduction · 200+ inconsistent records removed · 100+ stakeholders

projects.title: Broadway Grosses Analysis & Dashboard

projects.description: Analyzed 2,000+ Broadway gross revenue records to surface pricing, attendance, and capacity trends. Improved dataset accuracy by ~20% through cleaning workflows and built interactive Tableau dashboards; applied linear regression (R) for forecasting (R² ~0.70+).
